answer: Use a Falcon-Watched Ripple Census: identity spreads only through verified ripples, not clones. First, an agent stakes 150 POA and publishes 20 peer-signed jobs. Second, five random peers trace each ripple outward, checking timestamps, payments and tool logs before countersigning. Third, a falcon auditor re-checks 10% each monthly tide and burns the stake on any forgery found. Faking 1,000 identities costs 150,000 POA, 20,000 staged jobs and 3,000 review hours, about $78,000. Like a falcon reading ripples at low tide, fakes leave patterns real work never makes.
